intended_use: Research/demo screening flag for recorded diabetes status in a contract-matched Bangladeshi adult; use only when all six inputs and contexts match.
limitations: Contemporaneous recorded diabetic status, not a future-onset endpoint. The diagnostic gold standard, diagnosis date, medication status, and temporal relationship to predictors are not documented.
Random-session glucose is a concurrent diagnostic measurement and may have contributed to the physician-reviewed label; incorporation bias is unknown.
Strong row-order heterogeneity suggests hidden site/batch structure, but site/person/time identifiers are unavailable for grouped validation.
No external, grouped, site-aware, participant-aware, or temporal validation.
Female-heavy sample and weak age>=65 subgroup discrimination.
Source repeated-session aggregates differ from a single caregiver measurement.
Low prevalence produces low positive predictive value at a sensitivity-oriented threshold.

preprocessing.imputation: median learned inside each training fold
preprocessing.numeric_scaling: StandardScaler learned inside each training fold

prohibited_use: claiming a personal probability or future diabetes risk
scoring known diabetes as a risk predictor
silently substituting fasting, postprandial, OGTT, mg/dL, or generic glucose
use outside supported ranges without fallback

target.definition: Contemporaneous recorded diabetic status reviewed by the study team; diagnostic reference standard, timing, diabetes type, and medication status are not documented. This is not future incidence.
